name: MentalStatusObservation
title: Mental Status Observation
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
purpose: (Clinical Focus: Represents clinical observations related to a person's cognitive or mental status, including findings such as orientation, memory, attention, and perception.),(Data Element Scope: Used to document specific findings about a patient's cognitive function as observed or assessed during clinical encounters. This may include both normal and abnormal cognitive states relevant to overall mental status.),(Inclusion Criteria: Includes SNOMED CT concepts that are descendants of 373930000 |Cognitive function finding|, encompassing a range of mental and cognitive observations such as confusion, alertness, memory deficits, attention issues, and disorientation.),(Exclusion Criteria: Does not include psychiatric diagnoses (e.g., schizophrenia), mood or behavioral findings not directly related to cognitive function, procedural codes, or assessment tools (e.g., MMSE total scores).)
